Secretary of Interior Test

Does the +100% Production Buff Affect World Map Gathering?
Tested by Extremesecrecy | Server #2013 | March 23, 2026 | Radar Training Day (Monday)
[OWOW] Old World Order
Last War: Survival
Test Setup

Gathering scoring rules for Radar Training (Monday VS): 40 points per 100 Iron gathered from world map. We performed two controlled collections — one without the buff, one with it.

Scoring Rules & Starting Score
Test 1: Normal Gathering (No Buff)
Recalled troops — collected 93.6K Iron
Before: 9,739,242
After: 9,776,692
Points gained: +37,450
Expected: 93,600 ÷ 100 × 40 = 37,440 ✓
Test 2: With Secretary of Interior Buff (+100%)
Activated Secretary of Interior — then recalled 3 gatherers
Loot: 214,800 + 214,000 + 154,400 = 583,200 Iron
Before: 9,776,692
After: 10,010,032
Points gained: +233,340
Expected WITHOUT buff: 583,200 ÷ 100 × 40 = 233,280
Expected WITH buff (2x): 233,280 × 2 = 466,560
Side-by-Side Comparison
Metric No Buff With Buff Difference
Iron Gathered 93,600 583,200 6.2x more iron
Points Gained 37,450 233,340 6.2x more points
Points per 100 Iron 40.0 40.0 0% increase
Expected if Buff Worked — 466,560 Missing 233,220 pts

VERDICT

Secretary of Interior does NOT affect world map gathering

Points per 100 Iron remained exactly 40.0 with and without the buff.
If it worked, we would have seen 80.0 points per 100 Iron (doubled) — but we got the same rate.
The +100% Production buff only applies to base mine collection and Rapid Production.

What to Actually Do

  • Let your base mines fill up (they turn yellow when full)
  • Wait for Rapid Production to refresh
  • THEN apply for Secretary of Interior
  • Collect all base resources + Rapid Production while holding the position
  • Don't bother timing world map gathering around this buff — it has no effect
